text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times on the east and south sides of the curved section of Squirewood Road. The proposed amendment will enhance visibility of opposing traffic for vehicles approaching the curve and exiting adjacent driveways.

North York Community Council : 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the east and south sides of Squirewood Road, between a point 50 metres west of Edmonton Road and a point 56 metres further west and south.
